He submits that after the death, the parents of the deceased have made allegation of demand of dowry but prior to death no allegation was ever made before any of the authority.
O n the other hand, counsel for State has opposed the bail application and submitted that in view of the statement of witnesses bail application deserves to be dismissed.
Considering the overall facts and circumstances of this case, on perusal of case diary and statement of witnesses, I am inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail.
Therefore, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance on the dates given by it.
It is further directed that the applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437(3) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
